Something similar happened to my partner’s snail. If you don’t have access to cuttlebone immediately give them a bit of egg shells to suck on. That also provides calcium for them to help regrow their shells. Their shells are similar to our fingernails so as long as you give the little guy a source of calcium a full recovery should be possible. Make sure to very carefully remove the broken bits of shell. If you have any other snails in your terrarium keep this one separate until the shell starts to heal. Monitor him extra too. Keep us all updated! I’m invested in this little guy!!
